title: Come for the Games, Stay for the Community With GeForce NOW
summary: Save 30% with the Black Friday membership sale, claim a ‘War Thunder’ reward and explore 12 new games this week.
body_markdown:
Good games bring people together. This GFN Thursday,


[GeForce NOW](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/) is celebrating the members, creators and community moderators who turn every session into something worth sharing.


From friendships formed in online lobbies to new worlds explored on everyday devices, GeForce NOW Ambassadors share their reasons to love cloud gaming. Those ready to find their own can get 30% off six-month Performance and Ultimate memberships in the Black Friday sale and a special seasonal offer through Amazon Fire TV Sticks.


Plus,


*War Thunder* gets a new look with NVIDIA DLSS 5 for Ultimate members and a Ready for Battle Pack reward is now available across all membership tiers. Rounding out the week, 12 new games join the


[GeForce NOW library](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/games/) .


## **The Gamers Behind the Cloud**


Behind every screenshot, helpful tip and play session is a gamer with a story. GeForce NOW Ambassadors share what keeps them playing.


For


[Discord](https://discord.gg/2w6qF5BAS) moderator Luna, a low-spec laptop was the start of lasting connections: “Without GFN, I might’ve not been able to meet certain close friends … It has extended to me being given the privilege to be a moderator of an ever-growing community that links people together and continues to allow friends or partners to play with each other, regardless of what they own at home.”


After years helping moderate the community’s


[Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/GeForceNOW/) and


[Discord](https://discord.gg/2w6qF5BAS) spaces, Hamza went from an aging laptop to cloud gaming across a TV, phone, tablet and desktop:


*“* I’m genuinely thankful not just for the technology that keeps me gaming effortlessly wherever I am, but for the amazing community and friendships I’ve built along the way, and I look forward to what the future holds for cloud gaming.”


GeForce NOW kept new releases within reach for moderator


[Flacz](https://www.reddit.com/user/Adept_Assistance/) , without needing frequent hardware upgrades: “GeForce NOW allowed me to enjoy games and adventures I’ve never imagined to be possible and it continues to be a part of my daily gaming experience till this day.”


The cloud brings the games. The community brings them to life. “Cyberpunk 2077” photo by Flacz.


For creators such as


[Warwick](https://www.twitch.tv/warwick) , playing is only part of the picture: “GFN has allowed me to play the games I want, as soon as they come out. The support GFN has given me to create content for them and be partnered with them means the world and encourages me to get better each day.”


Freedom to play and create resonates with


[Nads](https://www.youtube.com/@CloudandConsole) : “Being able to jump into my favorite games in an instant without worrying about downloads, storage limits or constant hardware upgrades feels like magic … Being able to play my game and stream on YouTube at the same time is something I never could have imagined before.”


[Nigiri21Sushi](https://x.com/Nigiri21Sushi) also turns to the cloud when games stretch a local PC: “As a gaming content-creator, my current PC sometimes struggles showcasing new-release games that are CPU/GPU-intensive … Hence, huge thank you to GFN for allowing me to produce fluid content via cloud-gaming.”


For


[Marchief](https://youtu.be/sPDEqTaWZQs) , demanding games on Steam Deck are the draw: “I’m thankful that GeForce NOW allows me to play the top AAA games on the Steam Deck … Having the power of an RTX 5080 in a handheld is just absolutely mindblowing.”


[Markys](https://www.youtube.com/@MarkysCloudGaming) enjoys the comfort of the couch with his favorite game,


*World of Warcraft: Forever* : “No high-end gaming PC needed, just my controller, my TV and the freedom to play wherever I want.”


Anytime Anywhere Gaming shared a video that shared why GeForce NOW is “


[really fantastic in a whole lot of ways.](https://youtu.be/uMbFgt4xJXw) ”


Keep the conversation going on the community-run


[GeForce NOW Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/GeForceNOW/) and


[Discord](https://discord.gg/ZxRmJ4QDff) .


## **More Play, Less to Pay**


A little less spending. A lot more playing.


There’s still time to save 30% on the first six-month term of a


[Performance or Ultimate membership](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/premium-memberships/) . The Black Friday sale runs through Monday, Nov. 30, for new memberships and eligible upgrades in select regions, while supplies last.


Go


[Ultimate](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/premium-memberships/) for GeForce RTX 5080-class performance across PCs, Macs, Steam Deck and other supported handhelds, mobile devices, compatible TVs and


[more](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/system-reqs/) . Experience DLSS 5 in supported games, ray tracing and streaming at up to 5K resolution or up to 360 frames per second, with sessions lasting up to eight hours. GeForce NOW handles downloads, patches and updates for Ready-to-Play games, saving local storage for everyday essentials.


[Choose a six-month membership](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/premium-memberships/) before the sale wraps up and settle in for a season of gaming.


For big-screen play, GeForce NOW also supports Amazon Fire TV Stick devices, with a separate offer for 90% off the first month of Performance or Ultimate when purchased directly through Amazon in participating regions. Check out the supported devices and


[offer details](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-black-friday-2026/) .


## **Ready for Battle, Rewarded in the Cloud**


A new look. A battle-ready bonus.


Gaijin Entertainment’s


[War Thunder](https://store.steampowered.com/app/236390/) now supports


[NVIDIA DLSS 5](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/hogwarts-legacy-war-thunder-dlss-5-3d-guided-neural-rendering/) on GeForce NOW, bringing air, land and naval combat into sharper focus. Its 3D-Guided Neural Rendering technology adds lifelike lighting and materials, from tank armor to the water around a warship.


[Ultimate members](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/premium-memberships/) can experience the visual update with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud across supported devices, without an expensive PC upgrade. Keep the focus on the next maneuver and let GeForce NOW handle the power in the cloud.


To celebrate, GeForce NOW members across all membership tiers can claim the Ready for Battle Pack, now available.


The pack includes an M3A1 Stuart tank and F2A-1 aircraft, each with a unique skin, seven days of Premium account time, 100,000 Silver Lions, a 50% booster for Research Points and Silver Lions, and the “Overclocked” title.


Sign in to a GeForce NOW account and head to the


[Account Portal](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/account/redeem/) to claim the reward code, then activate it on


[Gaijin’s redemption page](https://store.gaijin.net/activate.php) . The reward is available through Friday, Dec. 25, at 11:59 p.m. PT, or while supplies last, with a limit of one per customer. Keep the great gaming going with this week’s additions to the GeForce NOW library:

Plus, Ultimate Members streaming from RTX 5080 cloud gaming rigs can experience


[Where Winds Mee t with DLSS 5](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/geforce-now-thursday-warhammer-dawn-of-war-iv-coming/) , enhancing the environments and characters of its wuxia open-world action role-playing game.


Dates listed above reflect when games are released on their respective stores. GeForce NOW availability may vary, as games are onboarded after release and added throughout the week. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW channels and GFN Thursdays for availability updates on announced titles.


Experience the best in GeForce NOW cloud gaming. Grab a


[day pass](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/) to try Performance or Ultimate before committing to a monthly membership, with the day pass cost applicable toward that first month.
